hook.name: HoodLocksFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for ETH/token pools launched via HoodLocksLaunch. Charges 1–7% ETH fees directly from swap inputs (buys) and outputs (sells), scaling with the previous swap's tick movement. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert. Pool initialization is restricted to the bound factory address.
